structure.raw_value: CaHaOp.See ya tomorrow.

source_text: Goodnight, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Goodnight, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Goodnight, Carol."

source_text: Bring me a working driveshaft and I can install it on the tractor.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.Bring me a working driveshaft and I can install it on the tractor.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.Bring me a working driveshaft and I can install it on the tractor."

translation: Przynieś mi sprawny wał napędowy, a zamontuję go w traktorze.

source_text: I fixed the driveshaft.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I fixed the driveshaft.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I fixed the driveshaft."

source_text: Let’s go! I can finally fix the tractor!

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx.Let’s go! I can finally fix the tractor!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx.Let’s go! I can finally fix the tractor!"

translation: Chodź! W końcu mogę naprawić traktor!

source_text: Are you going to come with us? Don’t you have work tomorrow?

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.Are you going to come with us? Don’t you have work tomorrow?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.Are you going to come with us? Don’t you have work tomorrow?"

translation: Idziesz z nami? Nie musisz jutro do pracy?

source_text: I can stay up a little longer.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I can stay up a little longer.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I can stay up a little longer."

source_text: There’s something on the wall. How can I reach it?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.There’s something on the wall. How can I reach it?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.There’s something on the wall. How can I reach it?"

translation: Coś jest na ścianie. Jak mam to dosięgnąć?

source_text: Nice job, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp.Nice job, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp.Nice job, 1Hero."

source_text: What are we going to do with it now?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What are we going to do with it now?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What are we going to do with it now?"

source_text: It can stay in the barn until Hannah has time to build a pen…

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.It can stay in the barn until Hannah has time to build a pen…
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.It can stay in the barn until Hannah has time to build a pen…"

translation: Może zostać w stodole, dopóki Hannah nie znajdzie czasu, by zbudować zagrodę…

source_text: She’s going to love her new pet!

structure.raw_value: CaHaOp.She’s going to love her new pet!
structure.script_literal: "CaHaOp.She’s going to love her new pet!"

source_text: What if it climbs onto things in the barn? Won't that be dangerous?

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.What if it climbs onto things in the barn? Won't that be dangerous?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.What if it climbs onto things in the barn? Won't that be dangerous?"

translation: A jeśli będzie wspinać się po rzeczach w stodole? Nie będzie to niebezpieczne?

source_text: Safer than being out there with the coyotes.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Safer than being out there with the coyotes.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Safer than being out there with the coyotes."

translation: Bezpieczniej niż tam na zewnątrz z kojotami.

source_text: Maybe we can make a pen before dinner.

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.Maybe we can make a pen before dinner.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.Maybe we can make a pen before dinner."

source_text: If I don’t get cooking, there won't be any dinner before sundown.

structure.raw_value: CaSaEx.If I don’t get cooking, there won't be any dinner before sundown.
structure.script_literal: "CaSaEx.If I don’t get cooking, there won't be any dinner before sundown."

translation: Jeśli nie zacznę gotować, nie będzie kolacji przed zachodem słońca.

source_text: I can put something together. Something small that will keep it safe until Hannah gets back.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I can put something together. Something small that will keep it safe until Hannah gets back.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I can put something together. Something small that will keep it safe until Hannah gets back."

translation: Mogę coś sklecić. Coś małego, co utrzyma je w bezpieczeństwie, dopóki Hannah nie wróci.

source_text: There’s wood out front. You two are welcome to try.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.There’s wood out front. You two are welcome to try.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.There’s wood out front. You two are welcome to try."

translation: Na zewnątrz jest drewno. Możecie spróbować.

source_text: We can do it. It won't take long.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.We can do it. It won't take long.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.We can do it. It won't take long."

translation: Dam radę. To nie zajmie długo.

source_text: I’ll get started cooking. It’ll be an hour before dinner.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I’ll get started cooking. It’ll be an hour before dinner.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I’ll get started cooking. It’ll be an hour before dinner."

translation: Zacznę gotować. Do kolacji została godzina.

source_text: Plenty of time.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Plenty of time.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Plenty of time."

source_text: This will be fun! We can make the little guy a nice home.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp.This will be fun! We can make the little guy a nice home.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp.This will be fun! We can make the little guy a nice home."

translation: Będzie fajnie! Zrobimy małemu lokatorowi ładny domek.

source_text: We’ll need some supplies.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.We’ll need some supplies.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.We’ll need some supplies."

source_text: Carol mentioned some wood in the front yard. I think it was covered in weeds last time I looked.

structure.raw_value: HeBaEx.Carol mentioned some wood in the front yard. I think it was covered in weeds last time I looked.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaEx.Carol mentioned some wood in the front yard. I think it was covered in weeds last time I looked."

translation: Carol wspominała o drewnie na podwórku. Chyba ostatnio było zarośnięte chwastami.

source_text: Something stuck to my electromagnet!

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Something stuck to my electromagnet!
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Something stuck to my electromagnet!"

translation: Coś przykleiło się do mojego elektromagnesu!
